name: audit_basic_counts
spec_quote: audit(rows) takes a list of {question, suggestion, joey, options, fact, sheet} and returns counts {agree, disagree, asked, open} and agreement = agree / (agree + disagree) rounded to 3 decimals (null when agree + disagree is 0), plus the list of the disagreeing rows (question, suggestion, joey, fact) in input order.
